name: How can I prepare my home for a room remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for a room remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for a room remodel, first clear the room of furniture, decorations, and personal items. Cover any remaining large items in adjacent areas to protect them from dust. Consider creating a temporary living space if the remodeled room is essential, like a kitchen or bathroom. Ensure clear access for the work crew and discuss logistics like utility shut-offs with your contractor. Proper preparation can help the project run more smoothly and efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by clearing the room, protecting nearby areas from dust, arranging temporary living spaces, and ensuring crew access.
